name: Tenant webhook capital intent waits for manager review
title: SC-09-06-04 Tenant webhook capital intent waits for manager review
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given an incoming tenant transfer is matched to a unit
When its description contains "Asansör Demirbaş"
Then the transfer stays in the reconciliation review queue
And no payment is allocated until a manager confirms its purpose
